protocol_name: Single-cell processing inside semi-permeable capsules: Encapsulation chip

events.narration: IR step 10 (droplets_1): encapsulate: FEED inlet_1 (cells_in_core_solution) at 2 uL/min, shell_polymer_in (shell_polymer) at 2 uL/min, fluorinated_oil_in (fluorinated_oil) at 10 uL/min, VENT outlet_1, all else capped. Co-flow the cell/core solution with warm shell polymer solution and focus with fluorinated oil at a flow-focusing junction to make droplets.
